issue: After the Supreme Court struck down the FDAMA's compounding advertising provisions in Thompson v. Western States, do the remaining FDAMA provisions that exempt compounded drugs from the FDCA's new-drug requirements survive, or was the whole statute invalid?

sides.position: The FDAMA was invalid as a whole after Western States, so the compounding safe harbor does not survive.
cases: Western States Med. Ctr. v. Shalala, 238 F.3d 1090 (9th Cir. 2001)

sides.position: Only the unconstitutional provisions were severed, and the remaining FDAMA compounding provisions remain viable.
cases: Med. Ctr. Pharmacy v. Mukasey, 536 F.3d 383 (5th Cir. 2008)

quote: But, thereafter, a circuit split ensued as to what, if anything, remained of the FDAMA and its provisions regulating compounders.
cite: United States v. Conigliaro, 15 F.4th 26 (1st Cir. 2021)
